name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_multi
title: Multi-column leaf keys: real (no trapdoor for B) vs simulated leaf view within 2x LHL (generic finite ring)
statement: As AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close, but the key is a tuple of L independent box-rejection tries, one per target column U l (a matrix target U). The real view (attribute 0, A = B R) and the simulated view (A = sum_i w_i W_i + B R) are within 2 * mW * sqrt(|K|^n / 2^m) / 2.
